name: Reclamation_HydropowerFacilities
title: Reclamation Hydropower Facilities
description:
This GIS layer represents the spatial locations and key attributes of hydropower facilities owned, operated, or managed by the Bureau of Reclamation. It is part of the Enterprise Asset Registry used to support infrastructure asset management, energy production planning, and operational decision-making. Each feature in the layer corresponds to a hydropower facility and includes associated metadata such as facility name, associated dam or project, region, generation capacity, and ownership status. The dataset is maintained by Reclamation’s Asset Management Office and is periodically updated to reflect changes in infrastructure inventory and operational status.

Definitions

Hydropower Facility: An individual site containing one or more hydropower units to generate electricity.

Reserved Works (Reserved): Reclamation-owned hydropower facilities, wherein Reclamation has retained responsibility for carrying out facility operations and maintenance activities.

Transferred Works (Transferred): Reclamation-owned hydropower facilities, wherein the responsibility for carrying out facility operations and maintenance activities has been transferred to a non-Federal entity under the provisions of a formal operations and maintenance transfer contract.
snippet: The purpose objective of the Hydropower Asset Class is to establish a single authoritative source in GIS format representing Reclamation’s entire inventory of Hydropower Facilities and implement processes and procedures for maintaining the inventory into the future.
